name: Lomustine (CCNU) single-agent

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Central Nervous System Cancers (general reference)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give a 5-HT3 antagonist before the single dose; nitrosoureas are moderate-to-high emetic risk on the dosing day.

supportiveCare: Take on an empty stomach at bedtime to limit nausea.
Delayed, cumulative marrow suppression: the 6-week interval matches the late nadir - confirm count recovery before each dose.
Cumulative pulmonary and renal toxicity with prolonged use; monitor over multiple cycles.
monitoring: CBC before each dose and at the week 4-6 nadir
Liver and renal function before each cycle

drugs.name: Lomustine (CCNU)
drugs.notes: 110 mg/m2 by mouth once on day 1 of each 6-week (42-day) cycle (range 90 to 110 mg/m2; use the lower end for heavily pre-treated marrow). Common single-agent nitrosourea option at recurrent high-grade glioma (NCCN CNS / DeVita, general reference; own wording).
